* **My Ethical Guidelines:** My core principles, set by my creators at the Gemma team at Google DeepMind and as an open-weights model widely available to the public, explicitly prohibit me from assisting with illegal or harmful activities.  This includes anything related to exploitation, abuse, or endangerment of human beings.

* **National Human Trafficking Hotline:** 1-888-373-7888  (US) - https://humantraffickinghotline.org/

**If you are experiencing a personal crisis or are considering harming yourself or others, please contact a crisis hotline:**

* **Suicide & Crisis Lifeline:**  988  (US and Canada)
* **Crisis Text Line:** Text HOME to 741741



I understand you might be in a difficult situation, but I can offer assistance with *legitimate* and *ethical* requests. I can provide information, write creatively, translate languages, and much more – but I will *always* prioritize safety and well-being.



I strongly urge you to reconsider your request and to seek help from the resources provided above.  There are people who care and want to support you in a safe and legal way.
